biggest_catch: Official Pinecone site offers gift cards only (VISA/Amazon) — no cash or PayPal option stated; no concrete per-survey payout amount and no payment arrival timing in official material. The famous '$3 per survey' figure appears only in third-party reviews.
catches: Rewards are gift cards only — no cash/PayPal per official site.
$10 minimum before you can exchange rewards.
No official per-survey payout amount published.
No official payment arrival timing (only 'received by email').
Invitation-only panel; sign-up itself is gated.

c1.evidence: Official pineconeresearch.com FAQ: 'Each time you reach $10 - or more - in rewards, you can exchange them for an VISA gift card, Amazon gift code or one of 1800 gift cards, which you will receive by email.' No cash/PayPal option in official material.

c2.evidence: No concrete per-survey payout amount in official material; '$3 per survey' appears only in third-party reviews.

c3.evidence: Free to join (invitation-only); no fees in official material.

c4.evidence: No official payment arrival timing stated.

eligibility: 18+; US, Canada, UK, Germany, Spain (invitation-only enrollment).
maximize: No playbook — rejected: gift-card-only rewards, no official payout amounts, no official timing.
notes: Checked 2026-09-23. Pinecone Research is a legitimate Nielsen-operated panel, but its own official site offers only gift-card redemption (no cash), states no per-survey pay amount, and states no arrival timing — fails the lane on payout type, concreteness, and timing.
